title: Bridge

act2.summary: one new value on each axis, at the same time

solutions.title: one FarePolicy hierarchy, one PaymentMedium hierarchy, bridged by composition
solutions.tradeoff: A new policy or a new medium is one new class and one new table entry - calculateFare itself never changes. The price: tracing a single combination now means opening three files (the policy, the medium, and the table that wires them together) instead of one class that did the whole thing.

reviewFocus: Does calculateFare's own body change at all between act 1 and act 2 on the solution route?
If a fourth payment medium arrived, would any existing FarePolicy subclass need to change?
Is the baseline's class explosion actually N×M, or does some sharing already claw part of it back - and where exactly does that sharing break down?
Would two enums plus a single class with a (policy, medium) => number lookup table be simpler than two class hierarchies, for a domain this size?
